notes:
Based on what I could confirm on the operators' own pages, here are the real preschool swim options for Oakville this fall:

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Preschool Swim Lessons (Levels A–E), Town of Oakville Aquatics",
      "age_fit": "3 - 5 years",
      "source_name": "Town of Oakville"
    },
    {
      "name": "YMCA Preschool Swim Lessons, YMCA of Oakville",
      "age_fit": "3 to 5 years old",
      "source_name": "YMCA of Oakville"
    }
  ]
}
```

Notes on what backs these up:

The Town of Oakville runs its swim curriculum on the Lifesaving Society's Swim for Life framework, and its own program guide lists 
Preschool levels A through E for ages 3 to 5 years, with a 1:4 instructor-to-candidate ratio
. Their fall booking page for this program is login-gated, so I couldn't pull an exact day, time or price — but registration is live: 
Fall recreation and culture program registration opens Tuesday, August 11 at 7 a.m.
, so that window has already opened.

The YMCA of Oakville separately runs its own preschool track: 
for children between 3 to 5 years old, the YMCA Preschool Swim Lessons program will introduce your baby, toddler, or preschooler to the basics of swimming
, with 
eight levels in the program: Splashers, Bubblers, Bobbers, Floaters, Gliders, Divers, Surfers, and Jumpers
. Their page didn't post a fall day/time or fee either, only that 
it's one class per week, and registration is required each session for both members and non-members
.

I did not include Goldfish Swim School or private studios — their Oakville pages read as general marketing copy without a distinct "preschool" class name, age-specific fit, or any fall schedule I could verify.
